title: A video as a WebGPU external texture under HTML cards
blurb: One shader pass samples a video frame and two HTML cards as separate textures. The cards are glass that bends the frame. A button times each way of getting the frame and the HTML to the GPU.
question: Can one WebGPU render pass sample a video as a GPUExternalTexture and DOM elements as element textures, and what does that cost per frame compared with putting the video inside the drawn element?
result: The pass works with the frame copied into a texture. importExternalTexture() failed on the software adapter of the test browser, so the external texture and the costs on a real GPU are measured by the page on the device that opens it.
